topic: The 10-minute conversation that gets your teen off the couch
caption:
The right question is more powerful than any lecture.

Ask your teen: 'What would you do with $200 this month?' Then help them figure out how to earn it.

That one conversation can shift everything — from bored to motivated, from waiting to working.

See how it works → hustleup.us
